items.title: Influencer Marketer
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE ElevenLabs is building the creative suite for the AI generation. Millions of creators and marketers already use our platform to generate speech, music, images, and video — and many of the world's best creators already talk about our products organically. It's time to turn that signal into a real program. We are looking for an Influencer Marketer to build our influencer program from zero to one. You will own the entire channel: strategy, creator sourcing and vetting, deal negotiation, briefs and creative direction, campaign execution around product launches, and measurement. This is not a coordination role — you will be the owner and operator of a channel we believe can become one of our biggest growth levers. We are looking for the top 1% of people in this industry. The right person has already taken an influencer program from nothing to something — with real numbers to prove it — and wants to do it again with more budget, a better product, and a faster team. You have sharp taste in creators and content, you negotiate deals that work for both sides, and you think about influencer spend the way a performance marketer thinks about paid: in terms of true incremental impact, not vanity metrics. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design and build the ElevenLabs influencer program from the ground up: strategy, creator tiers, budget allocation, and operating playbook - Source, vet, and sign creators across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X whose audiences match our creator, marketer, and developer segments - Negotiate and structure deals — flat-fee integrations, performance hybrids, long-term ambassadorships — and manage creator contracts with Legal - Write briefs that protect brand quality while giving creators room to be authentic, and give fast, decisive feedback on draft content - Plan and execute creator campaigns around product launches, feature releases, and cultural moments across ElevenLabs and ElevenCreative - Own measurement: work with our data team on attribution and incrementality (we already run a halo attribution model), and make continue/pause/scale calls on every creator and agency based on true ROI - Partner with paid marketing on whitelisting and amplifying top creator content, and with social to extend campaign reach - Build repeatable systems — sourcing pipelines, rate benchmarks, brief templates, reporting — so the program scales beyond you REQUIREMENTS - A proven track record of building an influencer program from zero to a meaningful, measurable channel — you can walk us through the before and after with real numbers - Experience negotiating and closing creator deals across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and/or X, including non-standard structures (performance hybrids, ambassadorships, usage rights) - Fluency in measurement beyond last-click: promo codes, UTMs, lift studies, incrementality, and the judgment to make budget calls when attribution is imperfect - Sharp creator taste — you can tell which creators will move the needle for a product like ours and which will just burn budget - Excellent brief-writing and creative feedback skills; you raise content quality without killing authenticity - Experience managing meaningful budgets and working cross-functionally with paid, social, product marketing, data, and legal - A genuine understanding of the AI and creative tools landscape — you follow the space, use the tools, and have informed opinions about where things are headed BONUS - Built or scaled an influencer program at a creative tools, AI, or developer-facing company (e.g., Canva, Adobe, Figma, Notion, Runway, or similar) - Managed 7-figure annual creator/sponsorship budgets - Experience on the agency or creator side of the table — you know how the other side negotiates - Built adjacent programs: ambassador, affiliate, or B2B thought-leader partnerships - Multilingual capabilities GROWTH POTENTIAL We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: - Lead the influencer and creator partnerships function as the program scales, building a team around you - Expand into broader creator/community growth ownership across ElevenLabs brands - Move into growth or brand marketing leadership as the Growth org evolves LOCATION This role is remote-first and can be executed from anywhere between the US East Coast and Europe, with the ability to collaborate across EST–CET timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: The goal of a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Scale is to own how we apply generative AI, agentic AI, computer vision, and reinforcement learning to mission-critical problems in production. Our senior machine learning engineers are handed problems that don't yet have an established approach, they propose the architecture, build it with support from other engineers, and are accountable for whether it holds up in the environments our customers depend on. Our Public Sector Machine Learning team is focused on deploying cutting-edge models to mission-critical government systems through products like Donovan and Thunderforge . Our work spans multiple modalities, with our primary focus on agentic systems built on large language models. We are developing agents that solve complex operational and planning challenges for government partners: agent frameworks that integrate custom retrieval pipelines and production APIs, memory and context-management systems that hold state across long-running tasks, geospatial reasoning over maps and spatial data, and the evaluation tooling that benchmarks and refines agent behavior. We also apply reinforcement learning in targeted places where it earns its keep, and our computer vision work advances evaluation, labeling efficiency, and multimodal model training in support of defense applications. As a Senior MLE, you'll have design authority over a capability area - the final say on the patterns used within your team, and the responsibility to make those patterns work under real constraints: classified environments, limited compute, and correctness requirements that don't bend. You will: Own the design and delivery of agent capabilities end to end - architecture, implementation, and the evaluation that proves they work Define net-new patterns in problem spaces with no established approach, propose them to the wider team, and lead the work to build them Take state of the art models developed internally and from the community and put them into production to solve problems for our customers and taskers Improve and maintain production models and agents through retraining, hyperparameter tuning, and architectural updates, while preserving core performance characteristics Build agent-level evaluation benchmarks, LLM judges, and verifiers - and use it to hillclimb performance rather than just report on it Partner with product and research teams to scope and shape high-impact initiatives, including for upcoming product lines Build scalable machine learning infrastructure to automate and optimize our ML services Work directly with government users and subject-matter experts, and translate what you learn into technical direction Act as a force multiplier and a primary reviewer for your team, mentoring at least one engineer, and your manager's go-to on feasibility questions Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders Treat security and compliance as design constraints to engineer around rather than blockers to route past Serve as a cross-functional representative and advocate for machine learning techniques across engineering and product organizations Be comfortable learning new technologies quickly and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Comfortable with light travel (approximately 10%) for customer interaction and team needs This role will require an active TS security clearance Ideally You'd Have: 5+ years of experience building and deploying applied ML systems in production environments Extensive experience with GenAI, Agentic AI, natural language processing, deep learning and deep reinforcement learning, or computer vision in a production environment A track record of owning architectural decisions and defending the tradeoffs behind them - not just implementing a design handed to you Experience shipping agentic systems with real production traffic and evaluation rigor, rather than prototypes or demos Solid background in algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented programming Strong programming skills in Python, experience in PyTorch or Tensorflow Experience mentoring or reviewing the work of other engineers Nice to Haves: Graduate degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning or Artificial Intelligence specialization Experience working with cloud platforms (eg. items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We're seeking an experienced Social Escalations Manager to be a founding member of a new pillar of our Operations organization: Community & Executive Escalations. This role is the front line of how Anthropic protects its reputation when high-stakes user issues surface on public social platforms.You'll help stand up the function from scratch and operate it day-to-day. You'll actively monitor brand and product conversations, triage emerging issues, and own social escalations end-to-end. During live escalations, you'll build real-time social reports that turn data into actionable recommendations to resolve issues quickly and reduce reputational risk. The ideal candidate pairs deep fluency in the social analytics landscape with calm judgment under pressure, sharp written communication, and a bias toward action. Key responsibilities Build the team's playbooks, escalation criteria, tooling solutions, and SOPs to successfully manage social escalations Actively monitor public social channels for brand mentions, surfacing potential escalations and triaging them against defined criteria Own social escalations end-to-end during your coverage hours Communicate crisply with internal stakeholders: brief executives on live situations, give Comms partners the facts they need, and keep incident channels useful and current Build social reports in real-time, using the data to drive actionable recommendations that quickly and effectively resolve live incidents and reduce reputational risk Write clear post-escalation reports that capture what happened, what we did, and what should change—so the next escalation is easier than the last Help iterate on the team's playbooks, response templates, escalation criteria, and SOPs based on what you learn running real cases Minimum qualifications 6+ years of experience in social analytics, escalations management, customer support, or a related front-line operations role—ideally at a consumer or developer platform Deep knowledge of the social landscape and hands-on experience using social listening tools (query writing, alert design, API pipelines, report building) Excellent judgment under pressure and have a strong instinct for how issues spread across public social platforms Sharp written communication—you can brief a senior leader in three sentences and document an incident so the next responder can pick it up cold Comfort coordinating across functions in real time and influencing partners without positional authority A pattern-detection mindset—you spot the second-order issue beneath the first-order complaint and surface it to the right people Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action; this team is brand new and you'll be helping define what good looks like as you operate Excitement about protecting Anthropic's reputation and relationships at a moment when public attention on AI has never been higher The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $210,000 — $260,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. The Codex team plays a key role in this by changing how software gets built and who can build it. The team is a fast-moving group within OpenAI that works across research, engineering, product, and design to build an AI software engineer. One that you can pair with, delegate to, or even ask to take on future tasks proactively. Design plays a critical role here. To succeed in our mission, it’s crucial that we make coding agents intuitive and accessible. We’re hiring a product designer to create products that are easy to use, beautiful, and push the boundaries of what’s possible. As an early team member, you’ll have a huge part in shaping our product direction and design culture. About the Role As a product designer on Codex, you’ll collaborate closely with a small team of product designers and cross-functional partners to shape the future of coding. You’ll partner closely with world-class engineers and researchers to bring cutting-edge capabilities into the hands of developers. Much of the work is 0–1, requiring you to balance a high-bar for craft, fast iteration, and strong product intuition. You’ll work on the end-to-end design of new features and improvements across a range of Codex products. You’ll help chart our course into the future as we evolve our technology, product, and design paradigms. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. items.title: Product Designer, Accessibility
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Design Systems team creates the foundations that help teams across OpenAI build coherent, high-quality experiences at scale. Accessibility is fundamental to that work. We’re building the shared standards, components, tools, and practices that make inclusive experiences the default across OpenAI’s products and platforms. About the Role In this role, you’ll lead OpenAI’s company-wide accessibility program from within the Design Foundations team within Product Design. You’ll pair strategy and organizational influence with hands-on product design (visual and interaction design) —advocating for disabled people, removing barriers across complete customer journeys, and establishing durable ownership throughout the company. This is an opportunity to define accessibility for a new generation of products spanning web, mobile, desktop, voice, AI, and hardware. You’ll help teams consider the many ways people perceive, understand, navigate, and interact with technology, going beyond minimum compliance to create experiences that are genuinely useful and inclusive. Working across design, engineering, research, product, go-to-market, and legal, you’ll make accessibility an expected part of product quality—not a final review or the responsibility of a single expert. This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role you will: - Design and ship product experiences while identifying systemic barriers across complete customer journeys. - Define OpenAI’s accessibility strategy, roadmap, governance, priorities, and measures of progress. - Build accessibility into our design system through inclusive components, tokens, interaction patterns, Figma libraries, documentation, and engineering guardrails. - Center disabled people through participatory research, usability studies, and assistive-technology testing rather than relying solely on assumptions, simulations, or automated tools. - Design for permanent, temporary, and situational disabilities, including multiple ways to perceive information, navigate interfaces, understand content, and complete important tasks. - Establish practical standards for screen readers, keyboard navigation, focus, reading order, contrast, typography, motion, captions, forms, errors, and multimodal interactions. - Lead accessibility audits, remediation priorities, launch readiness, and continuous validation across platforms. - Partner with go-to-market, legal, compliance, and product teams on enterprise readiness, accessibility documentation, procurement needs, and customer commitments. - Grow company-wide capability through training, critiques, engineering partnerships, and a network of accessibility champions. You might thrive in this role if you: - Pair deep accessibility expertise with a very high bar for design craft: strong interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and prototyping skills - Have led accessibility or inclusive-design work across multiple teams, products, or platforms. - Understand the relationship between accessibility, usability, and inclusive design—and know when to go beyond standards to meet real human needs. - Have deep practical knowledge of WCAG, assistive technologies, accessible interaction design, and platform-specific standards. - Have embedded accessibility into design systems, reusable components, and engineering workflows. - Have worked directly with disabled people and translated their experiences into meaningful product and organizational decisions. - Can identify assumptions and exclusion within a product journey, then turn those insights into clearer and more flexible ways to interact. - Are equally effective setting strategy, designing detailed experiences, and collaborating with engineers through implementation. - Can influence across disciplines without direct authority, creating shared accountability without becoming a centralized approval gate. items.title: Mechanical Design Engineer, Motor Design & Prototyping
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings. Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve peoples’ lives. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer to lead the development of motor mechanical designs and prototype hardware for advanced robotic systems. You will own stator and rotor mechanical development from early concepts and detailed design through hands-on builds and prototype validation, partnering closely with electromagnetic, electrical, test, and manufacturing teams. This role focuses on the design, integration, and validation of motor components and prototype processes, including laminations, stack assemblies, bobbins, winding interfaces, and fixtures. You will help drive motor development from initial design through repeatable low-volume builds while establishing the tooling, work instructions, and validation practices needed for future robotic platforms. This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and requires in-person presence 4 days a week. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Own stator and rotor mechanical designs and released CAD and drawings, including geometry, interfaces, fits, tolerances, retention, assembly access, and mechanical validation. - Develop laminations, stack assembly methods, bobbins, and winding interfaces that control alignment, insulation, conductor placement, and end-turn packaging. - Design, fabricate, and debug fixtures for winding, stacking, assembly, alignment, and inspection. - Build and troubleshoot prototypes. Use measurements, defects, rework, and assembly effort to improve designs and processes. - Establish low-volume prototype production with equipment, build sequences, work instructions, revision control, traceability, and acceptance checks that let technicians reproduce successful builds. - Test new manufacturing methods and winding approaches, balancing performance, repeatability, and practical implementation. - Work with electromagnetic, electrical, manufacturing, and test engineers to resolve tradeoffs between motor performance, packaging, buildability, and validation. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Move comfortably between CAD, the shop, measurements, and hands-on builds, and take ownership of the physical result. - Understand how tolerances, insulation, tool access, and assembly sequence affect whether a motor can be built and used reliably. - Diagnose failed builds through evidence and focused experiments, then carry the fix into the next iteration. - Build useful processes while designs evolve, and document them so others can reproduce the result. - Communicate assumptions and tradeoffs clearly and resolve coupled problems across disciplines. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience designing and building motors, actuators, or other precision electromechanical assemblies. - Experience with lamination stacks, bobbins, winding, insulation interfaces, or small-component assembly. - Proficiency in 3D CAD, manufacturing drawings, tolerance analysis, and fixture design, with hands-on metrology and inspection of critical mechanical interfaces. - Machining, additive manufacturing, bonding, or other prototype manufacturing processes. - Experience turning an initial build into a repeatable low-volume process. - Interest in using AI to reduce repetitive design and prototype work, with careful engineering review. items.title: Senior Legal Counsel - Privacy
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE The LeoVegas Mobile Gaming Group is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Legal Counsel focused on privacy, to join our dynamic and growing Privacy team. This is a pivotal role within the organisation, instrumental in safeguarding the personal data of our customers and employees, and ensuring robust data protection practices across our diverse brands, entities, and markets. You will play a leading role in the strategic development and operational implementation of our privacy program, with the opportunity of exploring more general legal and regulatory affairs focused matters, as necessary. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - As Senior Legal Counsel - Privacy, your core duties will include, but are not limited to: - Take responsibility for ensuring compliance with all privacy related laws and regulations for assigned entities, brands, and markets within the LeoVegas Mobile Gaming Group. - Serve as Data Protection Officer (DPO) for designated Group entities, fulfilling all statutory duties and responsibilities associated with the role, ensuring compliance with relevant data protection laws and regulations. - Collaborate closely with other DPOs and internal stakeholders on all pertinent data protection matters, contributing to a cohesive and effective privacy framework. - Conduct comprehensive data protection due diligence on prospective and existing business partners - Draft, review, and negotiate complex data protection agreements, clauses, and terms. - Draft, review, and update privacy policies and related procedures, privacy notices, and cookie policies for the Group and its partners, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and legal compliance. - Develop and refine internal procedures and policies to ensure robust personal data protection and GDPR compliance across all business operations. - Provide expert legal advice and guidance on a broad spectrum of data protection issues to various business units, senior management, and project teams. - Actively participate in and lead data protection workstreams within significant company projects, including mergers & acquisitions (M&As), ensuring privacy by design and by default principles are integrated from inception. - Take ownership of and lead major privacy-related initiatives, representing the Privacy team in critical cross-functional company projects and steering groups. - Mentor junior team members and contribute significantly to the professional development and knowledge sharing within the Privacy team, fostering a culture of continuous learning. - Contribute strategically to the evolution and implementation of the Group's overall privacy program and strategy, aligning with business objectives and regulatory landscapes. - Provide assistance and legal advice concerning data subjects' rights requests, ensuring timely and compliant responses. - Manage and provide expert advice on customer complaints related to data protection, including conducting thorough internal investigations, drafting submission, and preparing comprehensive reports. - Liaise effectively with data protection supervisory authorities and other regulators regarding complaints, inquiries, audits, and other regulatory matters. - Handle any data breaches and associated reporting requirements in a timely and compliant manner; - Ensure that material data protection risks are escalated appropriately and that regulatory reporting obligations are discharged within statutory timeframes. - Conduct, manage, advise on, and assist with Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), other privacy related assessments or investigations, and privacy audits, identifying risks and recommending mitigation strategies. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - A recognised legal qualification demonstrating a strong foundation in legal principles and analysis. - A minimum of 4-6 years of progressive experience in a dedicated privacy legal role, preferably within a multinational or complex corporate environment. - Deep and demonstrable expertise in GDPR and other relevant global data protection laws. - Proven experience in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex data protection agreements and privacy-related policies. - Demonstrated ability to act as a DPO or hold a similar lead privacy advisory role, including managing regulatory interactions. - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical business solutions. - Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to advise and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation. - Ability to work autonomously, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and evolving regulatory landscape. - Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. items.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack (FES)
items.description: About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. About the Team Every time a fan places a bet, earns a reward, or checks out on Fanatics — Fanatics Core made that possible. We build the shared foundations — identity, payments, loyalty, wallet, data, and platform — that power sports betting, ecommerce, collectibles, and beyond. We supercharge the business by providing products and capabilities so that teams can focus on what matters most: building delightful experiences for the fans. Fanatics is uniquely positioned at the intersection of sports commerce, betting, and collectibles, and Fanatics ONE is the loyalty and identity program that ties it all together. Overview As a Senior Software Engineer at Fanatics, you will design, build, and operate the platforms and services that power the Fan Ecosystem — the systems that connect fans to every Fanatics product and experience. You will own significant technical surface area end to end, set the technical direction for projects that span multiple services and teams, and raise the engineering bar for those around you through mentorship, design leadership, and hands-on delivery. This is a hands-on, full-stack role with a backend center of gravity. The majority of your work will be building high-throughput, high-availability services in Go, with meaningful contributions to the TypeScript/React front ends those services support. Responsibilities Design, build, test, document, and operate high-quality, production-grade software with a focus on Go services and APIs Own the technical design of medium-to-large features and systems: define the approach, weigh trade-offs, document decisions, and drive them to completion Break down ambiguous problems into well-scoped, deliverable work for yourself and other engineers on the team Lead and participate in design and architecture reviews; provide clear, constructive feedback that improves both the design and the designer Set the standard in code reviews — for correctness, readability, testability, and operational safety Mentor and grow engineers on the team; onboard new hires and act as a technical point of contact for your systems Participate in and improve the on-call rotation: instrument your services, drive incident response, and lead blameless postmortems that result in real fixes Improve reliability, performance, and cost of the systems you own; define and act on SLOs and operational excellence metrics Identify and pay down technical debt, and make the case for the investments worth making Partner closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to shape the roadmap and make technology decisions that grow the business Influence and help define the principles, guidelines, and best practices of our engineering strategy — then hold the team to them Develop deep understanding of our industry, product, feature set, and roadmap, and use it to make better technical decisions Required Qualifications 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems Strong, demonstrated proficiency in Go (Golang) — required. You have built and shipped production services in Go and can speak to concurrency patterns, error handling, testing, profiling, and performance tuning in the language Proven experience designing, building, and scaling backend services and APIs (REST and/or gRPC) in a distributed, microservices environment Demonstrated proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript, and experience with React or another modern front-end framework Solid grounding in data stores and messaging: relational and/or NoSQL databases, caching, and event streaming (e.g. Kafka, SQS/SNS) Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code Strong operational instincts: observability, monitoring, alerting, debugging production issues under pressure Track record of leading projects with multiple contributors and delivering them on time without sacrificing quality Familiar with Agile software product delivery and SCRUM methodology Able to effectively work cross-functionally within an enterprise environment Preferred Qualifications Experience building or integrating with identity and access management systems — authentication, authorization, SSO, and account lifecycle Hands-on familiarity with identity standards and protocols: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, MFA, session and token lifecycle management Experience with identity providers and CIAM platforms (e.g. Okta, Auth0, ForgeRock, AWS Cognito, Ping) or with building an in-house identity platform Experience with account security, fraud prevention, PII handling, or regulatory/compliance-driven engineering (KYC, GDPR, CCPA) Experience designing systems that serve high-traffic, consumer-facing products with spiky, event-driven load Experience with platform or shared-services work where your consumers are other engineering teams Experience working in a start-up environment Experience in sports, commerce, media, or another consumer-scale domain If you possess some of these qualifications but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply! items.title: Product Owner - Sportsbook
items.description: About us EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. About UXMatrix UXMatrix develops a broad range of digital products, including bespoke frontend applications, reusable templates, widgets, APIs, automated quality-assurance solutions, and a fully customizable WordPress-based CMS. Our products serve multiple operators, brands, and regulated markets, requiring us to balance customer needs, end-user experience, technical scalability, regulatory requirements, and commercial value. About the Role We are looking for a Sportsbook Product Owner to join the UXMatrix Product Team and take ownership of the development and continuous improvement of our sportsbook frontend experience. You will define what should be built and why, translating customer, market, and business needs into clear product outcomes and actionable requirements for the development team. You will work closely with design, engineering, QA, delivery, sportsbook platform teams, commercial stakeholders, and operators throughout the complete product lifecycle—from discovery and definition through delivery, launch, measurement, and optimization. The ideal candidate combines strong product thinking with an understanding of sportsbook user journeys, frontend technology, data, and agile delivery. You should be comfortable making decisions, challenging assumptions, managing competing priorities, and maintaining a clear product direction in a fast-paced environment. What You'll get to do: Product Vision and Strategy Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, objectives, and roadmap for the sportsbook frontend. Translate company strategy, operator requirements, market trends, and end-user needs into clear product priorities. Identify opportunities to improve sportsbook acquisition, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall user experience. Balance reusable product capabilities with operator-specific and market-specific requirements. Contribute to the long-term evolution of the sportsbook product, including personalization, modularity, scalability, and multi-tenant capabilities. Clearly articulate the business and customer value behind proposed initiatives. Product Discovery and Requirements Work with operators, commercial teams, internal stakeholders, and end users to identify problems, needs, and product opportunities. Analyze sportsbook journeys such as event discovery, navigation, search, market selection, bet placement, betslip usage, live betting, promotions, and bet management. Convert business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications. Break down complex initiatives into manageable and independently deliverable increments. Validate requirements with design, engineering, QA, platform teams, and relevant stakeholders before development begins. Ensure regulatory, responsible-gambling, accessibility, localization, and market-specific requirements are considered during product definition. Maintain complete, accurate, and accessible product documentation in Jira and Confluence. Roadmap and Prioritization Own and continuously maintain the product backlog. Prioritize initiatives and backlog items based on customer value, user impact, commercial potential, strategic alignment, risk, effort, and technical dependencies. Define minimum viable product scope and phased-delivery approaches for larger initiatives. Manage scope throughout the delivery lifecycle and ensure material changes are assessed, documented, and agreed with the appropriate stakeholders. Balance new product development, operator requirements, technical improvements, defects, and technical-debt reduction. Make clear prioritization decisions when capacity or timelines are constrained. Agile Delivery Work closely with engineering, design, and QA throughout planning, refinement, development, testing, and release. Ensure the development team understands the product objectives, user needs, requirements, and expected outcomes. Lead or actively contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and relevant product workshops. Provide timely clarification and make product decisions during development. Identify dependencies, risks, and blockers early and collaborate with the appropriate owners to resolve them. Accept completed work based on agreed requirements and acceptance criteria. Support release planning and ensure features are ready from a product, operational, documentation, and stakeholder perspective. Maintain delivery transparency and communicate progress, risks, scope changes, and decisions clearly. Stakeholder and Client Management Act as the primary product contact for assigned sportsbook initiatives. Build strong working relationships with operators, sportsbook platform teams, commercial stakeholders, engineering, UX, QA, delivery, and senior management. Facilitate product workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, demonstrations, and roadmap discussions. Set clear expectations regarding product scope, priorities, dependencies, and delivery assumptions. Evaluate stakeholder requests objectively and challenge solutions that do not support the product strategy or provide sufficient customer value. Present recommendations using evidence, product data, competitive analysis, and clearly structured business arguments. Support client presentations, product demonstrations, sales opportunities, and RFP responses when required. Product Performance and Continuous Improvement Define success criteria and measurable KPIs for new features and product initiatives. Monitor sportsbook metrics such as event-to-bet conversion, betslip completion, bet placement success, click-through rates, engagement, bet frequency, retention, and feature adoption. Use quantitative data, qualitative feedback, user research, and operational insights to evaluate product performance. Review delivered features after launch and identify opportunities for optimization. Work with UX and analytics teams to identify friction, abandonment points, usability issues, and unmet customer needs. Maintain awareness of sportsbook market developments, competitor products, user-experience patterns, and emerging technologies. Conduct competitor and feature-comparison analysis to identify meaningful product differentiators. Propose improvements that strengthen the UXMatrix sportsbook proposition and create measurable value for EveryMatrix clients. What we’re looking for: At least three years of experience in product ownership, product management, business analysis, or a comparable digital-product role. Experience in iGaming. Experience working with cross-functional software-development teams in an agile environment. Strong ability to translate business and user needs into clear, structured, and testable product requirements. Demonstrated experience managing product backlogs, priorities, scope, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make evidence-based product decisions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Confidence presenting product recommendations and reasoning with technical, commercial, and senior stakeholders. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives and competing priorities. Ability to understand technical concepts, frontend architecture, APIs, integrations, and platform dependencies at a product level. Experience using Jira, Confluence, or equivalent product and delivery-management tools. Professional proficiency in English. A degree in technology, economics, business, or a related discipline. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means establishing a clear and evidence-based direction for the sportsbook frontend, maintaining a well-prioritized and delivery-ready backlog, improving collaboration between product and engineering, and delivering measurable improvements for operators and sportsbook users. You will be expected to create alignment around what we build, why we build it, and how we determine whether it has been successful. Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. Access to an Employee Assistance Program through TELUS Health. Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. And did we mention our amazing office space complete with its own pool and gym? At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

items.title: Engineering Manager, International
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The International engineering team's mission is to expand Robinhood's products globally and scale our platform to support millions of new customers in diverse markets. We build and maintain experiences across onboarding, funding, account setup, localized product experiences, growth incentives, and platform capabilities to operate in new jurisdictions. Our engineering team partners closely with product, design, compliance, marketing teams, along with an array of platform engineering teams to launch new products and optimize user acquisition globally. We prioritize technical rigor, system reliability, and quick execution to deliver reliable products to our growing customer base. Our culture is centered on clear communication, strong team partnership, and a commitment to helping people manage their financial lives! As an Engineering Manager , you will lead a team of software developers to drive some of Robinhood’s most important international launch initiatives. You will be responsible for driving the architecture and execution required to launch crypto and other financial products in new regions, while shaping the reusable systems that make future launches faster, safer, and more scalable. You will guide technical execution, review system architectures, and ensure our services remain highly performant and secure at scale. In this role, you will recruit, mentor, and support the career progression of engineers on your team. You will work closely with product managers, compliance partners, and other team leads to define technical strategy and deliver features on schedule. Your leadership will directly shape how we scale our platform and deliver a reliable financial experience to our global community! This role is based in our New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week . At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Team Leadership & Development: Lead and support your team of developers, providing clear goals, regular feedback, and structured growth plans. Technical Strategy: Define technical direction and prioritize work with product managers and partner teams to scale our international products and systems. Architecture & Performance: Ensure backend services and localized products are designed for high availability, performance, and security. Talent Management: Manage hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluations for engineers on your team. Collaboration & Execution: Coordinate with product, design, and other engineering leads to deliver critical initiatives on schedule and meet defined business metrics. What you bring Experience: 5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years of experience managing engineering teams. Product Shipping Experience: Proven experience leading collaborative teams across product, design, and engineering to ship complex products, including end-to-end management from concept to launch, and ensuring high-quality, reliable user experiences post-deployment. Systems Design: Experience designing and operating distributed systems with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance. Project Delivery: Experience delivering complex technical projects from initial planning through execution and deployment. Communication: Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and business partners to explain technical decisions and trade-offs. Mentorship: Experience supporting team development through regular coaching, mentoring, and feedback. Leadership expectations Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them: Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech. Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly. Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. items.title: Customer Support Specialist II
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Customer Support Specialist II on the Premium Support team within Customer Experience, you'll serve as a subject matter expert for Coinbase's products, delivering world-class service to our highest-value customers. This team provides personalized, multi-channel support that directly protects customer trust and drives retention across Coinbase's fastest-growing segments. You'll own complex customer issues end-to-end across phone, messaging, and email, resolving problems at the root cause while guiding customers to unlock additional products and features. What you'll do: Own investigation, troubleshooting, and resolution of complex customer issues across phone, messaging, and email, driving first-contact resolution and logging defects when escalation is required. Build deep expertise in Coinbase products and the evolving crypto landscape, including blockchain, web3, staking, and derivatives, to advise customers and match solutions to their unique profiles. Identify customer needs proactively before they become issues, reducing friction and strengthening trust in Coinbase's platform. Partner with cross-functional subject matter specialists to escalate and resolve critical cases with urgency, ensuring accurate issue tracking and upstream solutions. Champion clear communication with internal and external stakeholders to align on resolutions, set expectations, and drive measurable improvements in the customer experience. Required Skills and Experience: 3+ years of experience in customer support or customer success in financial services, crypto, or technology, including direct experience supporting high-value customers. Basic working knowledge of blockchain, web3, staking, self-custody, and cryptocurrency markets. Demonstrated ability to investigate root causes, synthesize data and customer feedback, and resolve complex issues independently. Full-time, in-office presence five days a week with willingness to work nights and weekends to support the 24/7 nature of cryptocurrency markets. Proficiency in English with the ability to communicate complex product concepts clearly across phone, email, and messaging channels. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Job Description As a Complaints Analyst II within Customer Experience Team, you'll own the full resolution of escalated consumer complaint cases from intake through closure. This team provides elevated support to complaints agents by investigating and resolving complex customer escalations across consumer support pillars, including Payments, Identity, Crypto, and Compliance. You'll investigate root causes using internal tools, partner cross-functionally to unblock cases with external dependencies, and drive timely outcomes within defined service levels. What you'll do: Own and resolve complaint-related support escalations from intake through closure, ensuring cases are completed accurately and within defined service-level targets. Investigate complex consumer cases using internal tools including Salesforce, Control Center, and Athena to trace issues to root cause and determine appropriate resolution paths. Partner with internal teams such as Payments Risk, EDD, and Compliance to progress cases with external dependencies and unblock stalled escalations. Maintain accurate case records and update statuses daily to support operational tracking, reporting, and audit requirements. Identify recurring issue patterns and escalate process gaps to Complaints leadership with clear documentation and recommendations for improvement. Required Skills and Experience: 2+ years of experience in consumer support, complaints handling, or escalation management within financial services, crypto, or fintech, with exposure to one or more pillars including Payments, Identity, Crypto, or Compliance. Demonstrated ability to investigate escalated cases, trace issues to root cause, and drive independent resolution using CRM and case management tools (e.g., Salesforce, Athena, or similar). Proven track record of managing a full caseload independently, prioritizing multiple open cases simultaneously, and consistently meeting service-level deadlines. Clear, accurate written communication for both internal case documentation and customer-facing responses, with the ability to summarize complex issues concisely.
